Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes. A damaged item is handled as a warranty claim, not a standard return, because these products are custom-made. If the item is defective, made incorrectly, or arrived damaged, it can be repaired or replaced at no cost for up to 90 days from purchase; standard returns or exchanges are not offered unless there’s a defect.

Will I get a replacement or a refund?

A damaged item is usually handled with a repair or replacement, not a refund. If the product is defective, doesn’t work properly, or was made in the wrong size due to a production error, the same product in the same size can be repaired or replaced at no cost for up to 90 days from purchase, and return shipping for that repair or replacement is covered.

Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?

For a defective or damaged item, the repair or replacement itself is covered, and Select Blinds pays the shipping to send the repaired or replacement product back to you. Under the 3-Year Limited Warranty, there is a flat $15 return shipping charge when a defect claim is approved.

Most replacement claims are resolved by repair or remake under the warranty, but I don’t have a stated turnaround time for the replacement itself in the information here. What I can confirm is that custom products are typically made in 5 to 7 business days, and shipping usually adds another 2 to 7 business days, so many custom orders arrive in about 7 to 15 business days total.
